items.info: Pull handle below the Tilt Panel. Prevents the aircraft from rolling during prep.
items.label: Parking Brake

items.info: Main Instrument Panel. Controls the extension and retraction of the landing gear.
items.label: Gear

items.info: Center Pedestal. Increases lift and drag for takeoff and landing operations.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: Center Pedestal, speed brake lever. Nothing arms them: extend them by hand after touchdown.
items.label: Ground Spoilers

items.info: Electrical Panel, red switch, up for ON. The MFD comes on with a few CAS messages. The battery lasts 10 to 15 minutes, so connect ground power or start the engines soon.
items.label: Battery Switch

items.info: Electrical Panel. Puts the left and right generators on the main bus once the engines run.
items.label: Generators L/R

items.info: Electrical Panel, beside the battery switch, up for ARMED. Clears the EMER LIGHTS NOT ARMED message.
items.label: Emergency Lights

items.info: Electrical Panel, second row in the middle. Turns on the standby display between the two MFDs, the backup for attitude, altitude and airspeed.
items.label: Stdby Flight Display

items.info: Electrical Panel, second row on the right, down for DISPATCH. Powers only the left MFD and left FMS for preflight planning; the FMS radios are limited to COM1 and NAV1.
items.label: Avionics Switch

items.info: FMS: IDX → NEXT → MOD SET → Ground Power Unit = ON. Works only at a parking spot that has ground power. Without it the battery lasts 10 to 15 minutes, so start the engines before a long FMS setup.
items.label: External Power

items.info: Lighting Panel. Panel knob dims the instrument backlighting; turning it off DAY also switches the charts to night mode.
items.label: Cockpit Lights

items.info: Lighting Panel. Outer knob sets PFD brightness, inner knob sets MFD brightness, each side on its own.
items.label: PFD/MFD Dimming

items.info: FMS / Center Pedestal. IDX → POS INIT → SET POS TO GNSS. FPLN: origin and destination, or IDX → NEXT → ROUTE MENU → FPLN RECALL to load a SimBrief plan. DEP/ARR: departure runway and SID. Check the LEGS page, then PERF → PERF INIT for weights. The takeoff speeds need both the runway and the weights.
items.label: FMS Preflight
ATC Clearance
items.info: FMS / Center Pedestal. Tune COM1 on the TUN page.

items.label: Takeoff Briefing
items.info: Review the departure and check it is programmed in the FMS as briefed.
FMC / Center Pedestal. Set via FMS TUN page to transmit a transponder code to air traffic control.
items.label: Squawk

items.info: Pull handle below the Tilt Panel. Prevents the aircraft from rolling during prep.
items.label: Parking Brake

items.info: Exterior. Prevents the aircraft from moving on the ramp while parked.
items.label: Wheel Chocks

items.info: Exterior. Secures the main entry door for flight.
items.label: Cabin Door

items.info: MFD / Main Instrument Panel. Accessed below MFD → PASS BRIEF → TAKEOFF (LONG) or TAKEOFF (SHORT).
items.label: Passenger Briefing

items.info: Lighting Panel. Beacon and NAV on before engine start; logo lights on at night.
items.label: Exterior Lights

items.info: MFD / Main Instrument Panel. Monitors engine instruments and the crew alerting system for messages.
items.label: EICAS

items.info: Middle of the Tilt Panel. Manages cabin temperature and pressurization.
items.label: Climate Control

items.info: Center Pedestal. Fully back to idle before starting.
items.label: Throttles

items.info: Below the throttles. Press the starter for the engine you start first; the STOP light under the Run/Stop guard goes out.
items.label: Engine Starter

items.info: Behind the clear guard just above the throttles. Press without delay after the starter; it shows RUN. STARTER shows on the MFD, IGN appears at 12% N2, then N1 and ITT settle near 25% N1 and 600°C as IGN goes out.
items.label: Engine Run/Stop

items.info: EICAS / Main Instrument Panel. IGN shows at 12% N2; N1 and ITT then settle near 25% N1 and 600°C.
items.label: ITT

items.info: MFD / Main Instrument Panel. Monitors engine instruments and the crew alerting system for messages.
items.label: EICAS

items.info: Below the throttles. Follow the same start sequence for the remaining engine.
items.label: Opposite Engine

items.info: FMS: IDX → NEXT → MOD SET → Ground Power Unit = OFF. Skip if ground power was never connected.
items.label: External Power

items.info: EICAS / Main Instrument Panel. Verifies generator loads and battery charging status are normal.
items.label: Electrical System

items.info: Electrical Panel, second row on the right, up for ON. Powers all avionics for normal operation.
items.label: Avionics Switch

items.info: Middle of the Tilt Panel. Manages cabin temperature and pressurization.
items.label: Climate Control

items.info: PASS LIGHTS buttons, beside the exterior light switches. Play the seatbelt and safety announcements and cut off a passenger briefing still playing.
items.label: Seatbelt Sign

items.info: Center Pedestal, below the throttles. Set pitch, roll and yaw trim inside the green band on the EICAS trim display (AIL, RUD, ELEV).
items.label: Trims

items.info: Yoke and Pedals. Checks for full and free movement of the ailerons, elevator, and rudder.
items.label: Flight Controls

items.info: Center Pedestal, speed brake lever. Nothing arms them: extend them by hand after touchdown.
items.label: Ground Spoilers

items.info: Center Pedestal, right of the throttles. Extend the flaps, watch them move in the outside view, then retract them.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: EICAS / Main Instrument Panel. Confirms normal hydraulic pressure for flight controls and brakes.
items.label: Hydraulic Pressure

items.info: Tilt Panel, Ice Protection section. On the ground only engine anti-ice is used: at +5°C or colder with snow, slush or standing water, once the engines have run for 1 minute.
items.label: Engine Anti-Ice

items.info: FMS / Center Pedestal. PERF → TAKEOFF: check the runway, wind, OAT and QNH. NEXT: T/O FLAPS 15 (0 only when heavy or hot and high), then SEND. V1, VR and V2 show in magenta below the PFD speed tape, usually 90 to 140 knots.
items.label: Takeoff Data

items.info: Flight Guidance Panel. Engage and disconnect to verify the autopilot system is functioning.
items.label: Autopilot

items.info: Flight Guidance Panel, YD button left of AP. Leave it off after the autopilot check; it goes on after takeoff.
items.label: Yaw Damper

items.info: Main Instrument Panel. BARO knob on the display control panel sets the PFD; set the standby display with its own knob and check both read the same.
items.label: Altimeters

items.info: MFD / Main Instrument Panel. Monitors engine instruments and the crew alerting system for messages.
items.label: EICAS

items.info: Lighting Panel. Taxi and landing lights are the same lights at two brightnesses.
items.label: Taxi Lights

items.info: Pull handle below the Tilt Panel. Hold the toe brakes, then push the handle fully in.
items.label: Parking Brake

items.info: Rudder Pedals. Roll forward, then press the toe brakes to check the aircraft stops.
items.label: Brakes

items.info: Rudder Pedals. Steers the aircraft on the ground using the nose wheel.
items.label: Nosewheel Steering

items.info: Main Instrument Panel. Verifies primary flight displays are normal with no red warning flags.
items.label: Flight Instruments

items.info: Tilt Panel, Ice Protection section. Configures anti-ice and de-ice systems for current weather conditions.
items.label: Ice Protection

items.info: Center Pedestal, right of the throttles, middle position. Must match T/O FLAPS on the TAKEOFF page. The EICAS flap display, below the trims, confirms the setting.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: Center Pedestal, lever left of the throttles. Fully retracted, 0%.
items.label: Speed Brake

items.info: Center Pedestal, below the throttles. Set pitch, roll and yaw trim inside the green band on the EICAS trim display (AIL, RUD, ELEV).
items.label: Trims

items.info: FMS / Center Pedestal. TUN → TA/RA. Also turns on transponder altitude reporting.
items.label: TCAS

items.info: MFD / Main Instrument Panel. Configures the weather radar for precipitation monitoring.
items.label: Weather Radar

items.info: Glareshield. The button directly under the L ENG FIRE handle. Press when entering the runway: TO TO shows on the FMA and the flight director commands 10° nose up.
items.label: TO/GA

items.info: Tilt Panel, Ice Protection section. Heats the pitot tubes and static ports to prevent ice blockage.
items.label: Pitot/Static Heat

items.info: Lighting Panel. Brightest setting of the taxi lights.
items.label: Landing Lights

items.info: Lighting Panel. On when entering the runway, off once clear of it after landing.
items.label: Strobes

items.info: MFD / Main Instrument Panel. Monitors engine instruments and the crew alerting system for messages.
items.label: EICAS

items.info: Center Pedestal. Full forward to the TO detent. For a standing start, hold the brakes as the engines spool up.
items.label: Throttles

items.info: EICAS / Main Instrument Panel. Verifies the target N1 fan speed is correctly set for takeoff.
items.label: N1 Command Bugs

items.info: Rudder Pedals. Let go of the toe brakes once takeoff thrust is set.
items.label: Brakes

items.info: Yoke. Pull gently at VR, then hold about 10° nose up and follow the flight director.
items.label: Rotate

items.info: Main Instrument Panel. Raise once climbing with a positive rate.
items.label: Gear

items.info: Center Pedestal. Retract after accelerating through V2 + 10.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: Flight Guidance Panel. Engage after the flaps are up, no lower than 300 ft AGL.
items.label: Yaw Damper

items.info: Center Pedestal. Pull back to the CLB detent passing 1,000 ft AGL; FADEC manages climb power.
items.label: Throttles

items.info: Flight Guidance Panel. No lower than 300 ft AGL. FLC at 240 KIAS / M0.64 for the climb.
items.label: Autopilot

items.info: Tilt Panel, Ice Protection section. Configures anti-ice and de-ice systems for current weather conditions.
items.label: Ice Protection

items.info: Lighting Panel. Off above 10,000 ft.
items.label: Landing Lights

items.info: Main Instrument Panel. Press the BARO knob on the display control panel passing the transition altitude; STD shows below the altitude tape.
items.label: Altimeters

items.info: Center Pedestal. No autothrottle: set power by hand to hold the cruise speed after levelling off. Any position below TO works; there is no cruise detent. Stay under M0.77, or 305 KIAS below 27,884 ft.
items.label: Throttles

items.info: Tilt Panel, Ice Protection section. Configures anti-ice and de-ice systems for current weather conditions.
items.label: Ice Protection
Monitor Flight
items.info: PFD and MFD. Watch speed against the limits, and fuel flow, range and time to reserve on the FMS PERF pages.

items.label: Monitor Weather
items.info: MFD. Weather radar as required; outside temperature at the bottom of the MFD for icing.
FMC / Center Pedestal. For fuel economy, check PERF → FUEL MGMT.
items.label: Fuel Management
Approach Briefing
items.info: Review the approach and the missed approach, and have the charts ready.

Flight Guidance Panel and throttles. Top of descent ≈ (altitude to lose × 3) ÷ 1000 nm out. No autothrottle: in FLC, VS or VNAV, reduce power by hand to hold speed. Stay under M0.77 or 305 KIAS, 260 KIAS below 8,000 ft, and slow to 250 KIAS by 10,000 ft.
items.label: Descent

items.info: Tilt Panel, Ice Protection section. Configures anti-ice and de-ice systems for current weather conditions.
items.label: Ice Protection

items.info: Main Instrument Panel. Preset the local pressure, then press the BARO knob passing the transition level and check the altitude.
items.label: Altimeters

items.info: Lighting Panel. Strobes and logo lights on below 10,000 ft.
items.label: Exterior Lights

items.info: FMS: IDX → NEXT → MOD SET → CABIN LIGHTS: OFF, DIM or ON for the rear cabin. The PASS LIGHTS buttons only play announcements.
items.label: Cabin Lights

items.info: Lighting Panel. On below 10,000 ft.
items.label: Landing Lights

items.info: FMS / Center Pedestal. Needs the approach and runway selected in DEP/ARR. PERF → APPROACH: enter wind, OAT and QNH, then NEXT and SEND to put VREF and VAPP on the PFD.
items.label: Landing Data

items.info: Main Instrument Panel. Confirms avionics displays and navigation radios are set for the approach.
items.label: Avionics

items.info: PFD / Main Instrument Panel. Sets the decision height or minimum descent altitude for the approach.
items.label: Minimums

items.info: Flight Guidance Panel. APPR arms LOC and GS, or LNV and GP. For an ILS, tune NAV1 on the FMS TUN page first.
items.label: Approach Mode

items.info: Tilt Panel, next to the climate control selector. Manages fuel balance between the wing tanks if an imbalance occurs.
items.label: Fuel Transfer

items.info: Tilt Panel, Ice Protection section. Configures anti-ice and de-ice systems for current weather conditions.
items.label: Ice Protection

items.info: PASS LIGHTS buttons, beside the exterior light switches. BELT and SAFETY on for landing.
items.label: Seatbelt Sign

items.info: Center Pedestal. VFE 200 KIAS at 15°. Be at 200 KIAS or less before starting the approach.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: MFD / Main Instrument Panel. Accessed below MFD → PASS BRIEF → LANDING.
items.label: Passenger Briefing

items.info: Main Instrument Panel. VLE 200 KIAS.
items.label: Gear

items.info: Center Pedestal. VFE 160 KIAS at 35°. No faster than 160 KIAS by the FAF.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: Center Pedestal, lever left of the throttles. Fully retracted, 0%, before landing.
items.label: Speed Brake

items.info: PFD speed tape. Be at VAPP (VREF + 7 kt) by the final approach fix, then slow to VREF, usually 105 to 115 KIAS.
items.label: Airspeed

items.info: Flight Guidance Panel. Disengage no lower than 200 ft AGL.
items.label: Autopilot

items.info: Flight Guidance Panel, YD button. Off by 200 ft AGL with the autopilot, and always before touchdown.
items.label: Yaw Damper

items.info: Center Pedestal. Pull smoothly to idle crossing the runway threshold, then flare. The CJ4 has no thrust reversers.
items.label: Throttles

items.info: Rudder Pedals. Toe brakes once the nose wheel is down.
items.label: Brakes

items.info: Center Pedestal, speed brake lever. Nothing arms them: extend them by hand after touchdown.
items.label: Ground Spoilers

items.info: Center Pedestal, lever left of the throttles. Fully retracted, 0%.
items.label: Speed Brake

items.info: Center Pedestal. Increases lift and drag for takeoff and landing operations.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: Tilt Panel, Ice Protection section. Heats the pitot tubes and static ports to prevent ice blockage.
items.label: Pitot/Static Heat

items.info: Tilt Panel, Ice Protection section. Everything off except engine anti-ice, which stays on at +5°C or colder with moisture on the ground.
items.label: Ice Protection

items.info: MFD / Main Instrument Panel. Configures the weather radar for precipitation monitoring.
items.label: Weather Radar

items.info: FMC / Center Pedestal. Set via FMS TUN page to monitor surrounding traffic and provide collision avoidance.
items.label: TCAS

items.info: Lighting Panel.
items.label: Taxi Lights

items.info: Lighting Panel. Off once clear of the runway.
items.label: Landing Lights

items.info: Lighting Panel. Off once clear of the runway.
items.label: Strobes

items.info: Pull handle below the Tilt Panel. Secures the aircraft from rolling while parked on the ground.
items.label: Parking Brake

items.info: Electrical Panel, beside the battery switch, down for OFF.
items.label: Emergency Lights

items.info: Electrical Panel, second row in the middle, down for OFF.
items.label: Stdby Flight Display

items.info: Electrical Panel, second row on the right, middle position is OFF.
items.label: Avionics Switch

items.info: Middle of the Tilt Panel. Manages cabin temperature and pressurization.
items.label: Climate Control

items.info: Tilt Panel, Ice Protection section. Everything off, engine anti-ice included.
items.label: Ice Protection

items.info: Center Pedestal. Controls the engine thrust.
items.label: Throttles

items.info: Just above the throttles. Press each Run/Stop button once; both show STOP and the engines spool down.
items.label: Engine Run/Stop L&R

items.info: Lighting Panel. All exterior lights off.
items.label: Exterior Lights

items.info: FMS: IDX → NEXT → MOD SET → CABIN LIGHTS = OFF.
items.label: Cabin Lights

items.info: Electrical Panel, red switch, down for OFF. The last switch of the flight.
items.label: Battery Switch

description: A sophisticated light business jet with high performance and simple single-pilot operation for regional trips.
